historical_reviews.deepseek: Matches the three-drop hybrid boundary but does not prove device persistence or complete event history and leaves power timing, feed identity and recovery undefined.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Maintains conditional execution while making each abrupt interruption an individually evidenced safety and recovery checkpoint.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code row-804 OS-Watchdog/WDAT record was inspected; its BIOS UI and firmware-table purpose is unrelated and excluded.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Abrupt AC removal requires owner-approved physical control, protected pre-clear evidence and no automatic retry; finite Project inputs do not make the review permanently blocked.

original_test_intent: Verify that a fully populated SUT and its BMC recover correctly from three abrupt AC drops, without disallowed logs, hang, blue screen or loss of any expected CPU, DIMM, HDD, GPU or network device.
original_method: Bind the exact SUT and AC feed, preserve baseline state, then have a qualified operator perform three approved abrupt AC interruptions/restorations while automation records each action, outage, BMC return, host boot, complete inventory and event evidence before final comparison.
manual_activity: A qualified operator controls the identified AC feed and confirms each abrupt cut and restoration; the owner approves the data-loss exposure, dwell, safe final state and recovery authority.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC/PSU/feed topology and expected populated-device inventory
Definition of AC drop versus ordinary graceful cycle and exact off/on dwell
Three-drop window, boot/BMC readiness timeouts and final power state
Storage/data-loss policy and proof no protected workload is active
Protected BMC/OS access, evidence storage and console/OOB recovery
Abort thresholds for facility, boot, device, link, sensor, log and evidence failures
safety_requirements: Archive complete BMC/SEL/OS/device/sensor baseline before any approved clear
Never expose BMC or host passwords in command lines or logs
Operate only the verified feed; do not disturb redundant feeds outside the approved topology
Stop after the first unsafe facility condition, recovery timeout, hang, blue screen, reset loop, persistent error, device/link loss or evidence gap
Do not substitute a graceful reboot for the abrupt AC-drop stimulus
Do not automatically retry an anomalous drop
Return power and the SUT only to the approved safe final state
agent_execution_scope: Verify target/feed identity, expected inventory, timing and recovery readiness
Capture and hash the full pre-drop baseline
Maintain a three-entry action and recovery ledger
After each operator-controlled drop, collect outage/restoration times, BMC reachability, host boot/readiness, complete inventory and raw BMC/OS events
Enforce stop conditions and preserve anomalies without retry
Compare final health without touching unapproved power controls or issuing the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the abrupt-drop interpretation, feed, dwell, storage exposure and abort matrix
Perform or directly supervise all three physical power actions
Own facility safety, any evidence clear and recovery decisions
Review complete per-drop evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The operator-performed three-drop direction fits Items, but a boot marker and last 30 SEL lines cannot establish complete recovery, device retention or absence of transient errors; password-bearing ipmitool arguments are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use target-bound read-only BMC/OS/inventory collectors and an integrity-protected three-drop ledger around qualified operator actions; select exact collectors only after interfaces and credential handling are approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Three AC drops, full CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network population, 30/60-minute estimates and every no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen/no-device-loss criterion remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve baseline, perform one authorized abrupt drop at a time, prove complete BMC/host/device recovery before advancing, stop on the first failed gate and close with final-state comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact feed identity, abrupt-loss semantics, dwell/readiness gates, per-drop traceability, safe secrets and recovery ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final-only or truncated log cannot prove that each separate drop recovered every populated device or remained free of transient faults.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Abrupt loss can corrupt in-flight writes, stress power/storage and remove both host and management access; physical and facility risk remains human-owned.

project_override_considerations: If the Project interprets `AC drop` as a facility-controlled outage rather than a conventional AC cycle, that distinction and its exact timing must be recorded. A graceful reboot or DC cycle is not equivalent coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved target/feed topology, populated inventory, abrupt-drop definition, timing, operator and abort matrix
Immutable full pre-clear BMC/SEL/OS/device/sensor/storage baseline and any authorized clear record
Three-entry ledger with physical confirmation plus cut, restore, BMC return and host readiness timestamps
Complete per-drop device inventory, BMC/OS events, sensors, links and recovery evidence
Any timeout, hang, blue screen, unexpected reset, device/link loss, error or evidence-gap record
Final health/inventory comparison, approved power state, recovery audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe a three-event AC-loss recovery test. The procedure's generic `AC Power Cycle` wording requires a Project timing definition but does not erase the title's abrupt-drop purpose; duplicate row 804 is independently identified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact feed, abrupt-drop timing, operator, protected window and recovery are supplyable readiness inputs. The operation and acceptance direction are sufficiently identifiable for a conditional review.

review_improvement: Preserves DeepSeek's correct operator/automation split while adding abrupt-loss semantics, all-device recovery, complete per-drop evidence, safe credential handling and stop/recovery governance.
independent_technical_reasoning: An AC drop differs from a scheduled reboot because host and storage cannot quiesce after the cut. Evidence therefore has to establish both the actual outage and complete recovery for each of the three events; advancing after a failed recovery would compound risk and invalidate the sequence.
